summary: Town page + map read: 10 RV sites (30 A + water) and 6 tent sites, showers and a dump station; $31 card / $30 cash; open May 1-Sep 30 (now confirmed, 'approximate' dropped). Seasonal and monthly rates exist, share not stated. Not waterfront kept (river ~300 m). Google 4.9 (8). Phone: campground host 218-410-4645 suggested over the town hall line.
